name: reasoning-bridge
description: Run a one-time local ChatGPT web consultation for a remote Codex task.

interface.shortDescription: Advise a remote Codex task through ChatGPT web.
interface.longDescription: Read a remote Codex thread, draft a natural engineering brief, ask a signed-in ChatGPT web advisor, and return the answer to that task.
capabilities: Return decisions to the originating execution task
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $reasoning-bridge with a remote thread ID, then return the web advisor decision to that remote task.
